title: Naldehra & Mashobra: Shimla's Quiet Deodar Retreats (Golf Course, Snow, How to Reach)
seo_title: Naldehra & Mashobra near Shimla: Golf, Snow & How to Reach
seo_desc: Naldehra (about 22 km from Shimla) and Mashobra (about 12 km): India's high old golf course, deodar woods, Mahunag and Tattapani nearby, snow from December to February, and how to fit both into a Shimla trip.
